title.value: Dynamics of SGD with Stochastic Polyak Stepsizes: Truly Adaptive Variants and Convergence to Exact Solution
title.justification: This is the title provided at the beginning of the paper.
title.quote:
Dynamics of SGD with Stochastic Polyak Stepsizes: Truly Adaptive Variants and Convergence
to Exact Solution

analysis.description: This paper discusses modifications to the stochastic gradient descent (SGD) using stochastic Polyak stepsizes (SPS) to address the limitations of previous formulations, specifically in non-over-parameterized regimes. The new variants aim to ensure convergence to the exact minimizer without requiring prior knowledge of optimal mini-batch losses. The authors propose DecSPS, which is a novel modification that guarantees convergence to the exact solution, especially for strongly-convex optimization problems. The paper includes theoretical contributions as well as empirical validations through experiments.

type.justification: The paper primarily presents a theoretical analysis of the dynamics and convergence properties of SGD with new variants of SPS, particularly focusing on convergence proofs and theoretical improvements over existing methods.
type.quote:
In this work, we study the dynamics and the convergence properties of SGD equipped with new
variants of the stochastic Polyak stepsize and provide solutions to both drawbacks of the original SPS.

name.justification: The paper focuses on optimization techniques for machine learning, specifically involving stochastic gradient descent and real-time adaptation of stepsizes for convergence in optimization problems.
